name: Finn Mac Cumhail
source: Finn Mac Cumhaill is the young captain of the Fianna. He may not look like much of a threat, but underneath his lackadaisical exterior beats the heart of a true leader. Because his reputation often precedes him, the men he commands might admit to following him just to see what feats the legendary boy warrior will pull off next. Blessed with near-omnipotence that he uses his advantage, Finn plunges headfirst into dire situations and always comes out on top some way or another.
